牌逢对手尽在「相位对弈」赛事活动！
由守密人们自发组成的赛事组竭诚举办的第5届「塔薇杯」将于9月18日正式开赛，届时Bilibili、Discord双平台将同步开启直播！欢迎所有人报名参赛~

**🙌 赛事流程**
🔹 报名时间：截止<t:1788710340:f>
🔹 报名方式：点击以下任一链接填写报名表
https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DSkd6S1p6a3NzTmFY
https://forms.gle/i4VBRubAZhpicXcT7
🔹 比赛时间：9月18日（UTC+8）开始
🔹 直播链接
Bilibili @God7777：https://space.bilibili.com/22359359
Discord语音频道“全球GLOBAL-相位对弈赛事丨Traphase Tournament”：https://discord.gg/CbPTHnSAaF

**📑 赛事规则**
本届赛事将采用“循环积分赛+双败淘汰赛”的赛制。

🔹 循环积分赛
所有参赛选手随机分组，每组6~8人，组内进行Bo1单循环赛，胜者积1分，败者不积分。每组积分最高的2名选手出线，如出现多名选手并列组内第二的情况则由赛事组安排加赛。

🔹 双败淘汰赛
> 所有出线选手初始默认进入胜者组，落败后进入败者组，再次落败即被淘汰。每个轮次，同组选手随机匹配进行Bo1。
> 当胜者组、败者组各余1名选手时，两人进行决赛。败者组选手需连胜2局方可夺冠。
> 根据淘汰顺序进行赛事排名：越晚被淘汰，排名越靠前。

**📌 编队规则**
赛事报名截止后，赛事组将会使用随机工具为每名选手指定1项必须用于编队的“基底”。一共有如下8项可随机到的“基底”：
> 珈伦、法洛思
> 猎食决心、奥瑞塔的宝藏
> 无声欢宴、于暴雨之中、向上坠落、好运时间
除了指定“基底”之外，队伍中还必须编入1名“祝福”定位的唤醒体、1名“灵智”定位的唤醒体。

选手按照要求完成编队后需在规定时间内提交给赛事组，正式比赛开始前赛事组会公布所有选手的队伍情况。
🔹 提交时间：截止<t:1789142340:f>
🔹 公布时间：9月13日（UTC+8）

每场比赛结束后，胜者需按照以下规则更新队伍。
> 从败者队伍中选择1项“基底”替换掉自己队伍中的1项“非基底”。
> 如败者队伍中的“基底”均已存在，则需选择1项其他“基底”替换掉自己队伍中的1项“非基底”。
> 如8项基底均已存在，队伍将被锁定。

**🎁 赛事奖励**
🥇 冠军：50元
🥈 亚军：30元
🥉 季军：20元
🏅 四强：头像框·维度桂冠
😆 笑声制造奖：所有打出令人捧腹大笑的操作的选手将入选“名人堂”并获得特别奖金，其中1名选手可获得10元奖金与至高称号，另有6名选手可分别获得5元奖金。

在此，感谢每一位积极组织、踊跃参与赛事的守密人！祝各位玩得开心🍻~
💡 主办方拥有本活动的最终解释权。

thread_title: 🏆 忘却前夜第5届塔薇杯┊The 5th Tawil Cup of Morimens

content:
Face off against worthy opponents in the Traphase tournament!

The 5th Tawil Cup, organized entirely by Keepers, will officially kick off on September 18 (UTC+8). Live streams will be available simultaneously on Bilibili and Discord! Everyone's welcome to sign up and join the fun~

**🙌 Tournament Process**
🔹 Registration Deadline: <t:1788710340:f>
🔹 Registration Method: Click on the link (https://forms.gle/i4VBRubAZhpicXcT7 ) to complete the registration form.
🔹 Tournament Start Time: September 18 (UTC+8)
🔹 Livestream Links
Bilibili @God7777: https://space.bilibili.com/22359359
Discord Voice Channel "全球GLOBAL-相位对弈赛事丨Traphase Tournament": https://discord.gg/CbPTHnSAaF

**📑 Tournament Rules**
This tournament utilizes a "Round-Robin + Double-Elimination" format.

🔹 Round-Robin Stage
All participants are randomly assigned to groups of 6–8 players. A single round-robin (Bo1) is played within each group; winners earn 1 point, while losers earn 0. The top two players from each group advance. In the event of a tie for second place, the tournament organizers will arrange a tie-breaker match.

🔹 Double-Elimination Stage
> All advancing players start in the Winners' Bracket; a loss sends them to the Losers' Bracket, and a subsequent loss results in elimination. In each round, players within the same bracket are randomly matched for a Bo1 match.
> When one player remains in the Winners' Bracket and one in the Losers' Bracket, they face off in the Grand Final. The player from the Losers' Bracket must win two consecutive matches to claim the championship.
> Rankings are determined by the order of elimination: the later a player is eliminated, the higher their final ranking.

**📌 Team Building Rules**
The tournament organizers will use a random tool to assign each player one "base" for their team. There are eight randomly generated "bases":
> Karen、Faros
> Voracious Resolve、Aurita's Treasure
> Silent Banquet、Amidst the Downpour、Falling Upward、Hour of Fortune

In addition to the assigned "base", each team must include one Awakener with the "Divinia" role and one Awakener with the "Luminis" role.

After completing their team formations, players must submit them to the tournament organizers within the specified time. The organizers will announce the team information for all players before the official start of the competition.
🔹 Submission Deadline: <t:1789142340:f>
🔹 Announcement time: September 13 (UTC+8)

After each match, the winner must update their team according to the following rules:
> Select one "base" from the loser's team to replace one "non-base" from their own team.
> If all "bases" already exist in the loser's team, they must select one other "base" to replace one "non-base" from their own team.
> If all 8 "bases" already exist, the team will be locked.

**🎁 Tournament Rewards**
🥇 Champion: 50 CNY
🥈 Runner-up: 30 CNY
🥉 Third Place: 20 CNY
🏅 Top 4: Avatar Frame-Dimensional Laurels
😆 Laughter Maker Award: All players who execute hilarious plays will be inducted into the "Hall of Fame" and receive a special bonus. One player will receive 10 CNY and supreme title, and six other players will each receive 5 CNY.

We would like to thank every Keeper who actively organized and participated in the tournament! Have fun! 🍻~
💡 The organizer reserves the right to final interpretation of this event.
